newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar and stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar and stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against both the dollar and sterling on Thursday reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a commercial mean rate of 20.4535 to the dollar from 20.3095 on Wednesday, and at a commercial mean rate of 33.6725 to the sterling from 33.6325 on Wednesday.
Forex dealers said that the international market was very volatile and bullish and that the dollar was maintained stronger against other currencies since Wednesday morning.
Dealers said that the local market was square and there was no big activity in the inter-bank forex market.
